title: 第17章 开门第18章 瘦长鬼影
content_zh:
;;
一进入内景世界，张唯只感觉脑海中热流越发浓郁，不断回荡，那些咒语所印刻的含义也越发深邃，真言念诵，引动神明，刹那间清晰得如同掌上观纹。
每个结印，手指的屈伸和指尖完美角度，仿佛与生俱来的本能，流畅得不可思议。
最关键的是力量。
他心念微动，内景世界中，指尖尚未完全结印，体内那股吸纳天地灵气炼化的气已如臂使指，在丹田蠢蠢欲动，就要随着结印喷薄而出。
但他硬生生止住了，眼下安全屋内的天地灵气已经彻底枯竭，体内的气得不到补充，用一点少一点，得用在刀刃上才行。
气要是用完，那就得耗血了。
他这服身板，可遭不住几回。
最让张唯欣喜的是，天罡驱邪咒精通之后，消耗似乎也小了些。
良久，张唯从脱离内景世界，视界上蓦地跳出一道信息。
‘天罡驱邪咒（精通），日夜念诵完美级三百六十五次后大成’
日夜念诵完美级三百六十五次。
按照现在一天能出现一次的完美念诵进度，得一年的时间，是不是有些太久了。
张唯有些吐槽，但眼下不是纠结这件事情的时候，等后面空下来看看有没有什么办法能缩短。
有了精通的天罡驱邪咒，现在还等什么。
从内景世界退出后。
张唯几乎是扑向那套哑黑色的战术防刺轻甲。
这件轻甲由高强度纤维与防护片复合而成，入手微沉却异常贴身，穿上后活动了几下，关节处毫无滞涩。
他郑重地将打磨得寒光闪闪的入鞘苗刀挂在腰侧皮革搭扣上。
装备齐整，安全感似乎也厚实了几分。

整装待发后，张唯再次盘膝坐定，意识如沉入深海的游鱼，瞬间滑入内景世界。
一进入内景世界，他低头一看。
哈！成了！
张唯心中狂喜。
身上正是那套现实中的哑黑轻甲，触感冰凉坚实。
腰间苗刀的重量感也真实不虚地传递过来。
他忍不住拔出半截刀身，屈指弹了下刀身，一声低沉的嗡鸣在内景的死寂中荡开。
这地方真够意思，连装备都能复刻，那以后要是能弄把枪……
这个念头像颗火星，烫得他心跳快了一拍。
广阔天地，大有可为。
不过兴奋很快被现实浇灭，眼下不是考虑这个的时候。
平复心绪，张唯盘膝运转《小周天服气法》，试图汲取这安全屋内最后残存的灵气。
十五分钟后，他无奈睁眼。
周围都是空的感应。
灵气是彻底的枯竭。
连一丝都感应不到了，丹田内那点好不容易积攒的气也沉寂着，只有在感受他的引动，才从丹田出来。
这感觉，就像鱼被抛上了干涸的河岸，浑身不得劲。
不过张唯并没有太多情绪，这是他预料之内的事情。
他的目光不可避免看向了那扇隔绝内外，看起来锈迹斑斑的老式防盗门。
门后便是那片吞噬光线，诡谲莫测的黑暗走廊。

他这次整装待发，就是为了探索门外的世界。
content_en:
;;
As soon as he entered the interior world, Zhang Wei felt the heat in his mind getting stronger and stronger, constantly reverberating, and the meanings imprinted on those mantras became more and more profound. The chanting of mantras inspired the gods, and they were as clear as the lines on the palm of his hand.
Each seal, the flexion and extension of the fingers and the perfect angle of the fingertips are as if they are innate instincts and are incredibly smooth.
The most important thing is strength.
His thoughts moved slightly. In the inner world, the fingertips had not yet completely formed the seal. The energy in his body that had been refined by absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was already moving like his arms and fingers. It was ready to move in the Dantian and was about to spurt out along with the seal.
But he stopped abruptly. At present, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the safe house had been completely exhausted, and the energy in his body could not be replenished. He had to use a little less, and he had to use it on the edge of the knife.
If you run out of Qi, you will have to consume blood.
He can't stand it a few times in this state.
What makes Zhang Wei most happy is that after mastering the Tiangang Exorcism Curse, the consumption seems to be less.
After a long time, Zhang Weicong left the interior world, and a message suddenly popped out of his field of vision.
‘Tiangang Exorcism Mantra (Mastery), perfect after reciting it 365 times day and night’
Recite the Perfect Level three hundred and sixty-five times day and night.
According to the current progress of perfect chanting that can occur once a day, it will take a year, which is a bit too long.
Zhang Wei complained a little, but now is not the time to dwell on this matter. He will see if there is any way to shorten it later when he is free.
With the proficient Tiangang exorcism spell, what are you waiting for now?
After exiting the interior world.
Zhang Wei almost pounced on the matte black tactical stab-proof light armor.
This light armor is made of high-strength fibers and protective sheets. It is light in the hand but extremely close to the body. After wearing it for a few times, there is no stagnation in the joints.
He solemnly hung the sheathed Miao knife that was polished to a cold light on the leather buckle at his waist.
The equipment is complete and the sense of security seems to be a bit thicker.
After getting ready, Zhang Wei sat cross-legged again, his consciousness slipping into the interior world like a fish sinking into the deep sea.
Once he entered the interior world, he looked down.
ha! Done!
Zhang Wei was ecstatic.
He was wearing the same matte black light armor in reality, which felt cold and solid to the touch.
The weight of the knife at the waist is also conveyed in a real way.
He couldn't help but pull out half of the blade, flicked the blade with his fingers, and a low hum sounded in the dead silence of the interior scene.
This place is really interesting. Even the equipment can be reproduced. If I can get a gun in the future...
This thought was like a spark, making his heart beat faster.
The vast world has a lot to offer.
However, the excitement was quickly extinguished by reality, and now was not the time to think about this.
After calming down his mind, Zhang Wei crossed his legs and ran the "Xiao Zhoutian Conquering Qi Technique", trying to absorb the last remaining spiritual energy in this safe house.
Fifteen minutes later, he reluctantly opened his eyes.
There is a feeling of emptiness all around.
The spiritual energy is completely exhausted.
Not even a trace of it could be sensed, and the qi that had finally been accumulated in the dantian was silent. Only when he felt his induction could he come out of the dantian.
This feeling is like a fish being thrown onto a dry river bank, feeling uncomfortable all over.
However, Zhang Wei didn't have much emotion, which was what he expected.
His eyes inevitably turned to the rusty-looking old-fashioned security door that separated the inside and outside.
Behind the door is the dark corridor that swallows light and is unpredictable.
He got ready to go this time just to explore the world outside the door.
